description: Residential proxy for AI agents. Pay for gigabytes of traffic and get a proxy login (host, port, username, password) after payment, to use with curl, a browser or any HTTP client. Choose a country, rotate the IP on every connection or keep one with a session tag. A pack lasts 90 days. Pay per pack in stablecoins. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

country.description: optional default exit country, a two-letter code such as DE or US; the username can override it per connection

gb.description: gigabytes of traffic in the pack (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes, counted on both directions)

name: proxy
title: Residential proxy pack
